evidence_against: The exact full-length/ATP/phosphorylation-site RCSB phrase scout reviewed 110 unique PDB IDs and found only repeat 5HVK as a heteromeric gamma/acceptor lead.
Europe PMC returned 68 rows across three PubMed-style query surfaces; top family/paper leads did not introduce a fresh clean transfer-state structure.
PINK1/ubiquitin is split-state: 6EQI has kinase-substrate context but no gamma donor, while 5YJ9/8UYH have AMP-PNP on PINK1 without ubiquitin substrate.
PKA/CFTR entries 9DW5/9DW7/9DW8/9DW9 have source-context complexes but no heteromeric CFTR acceptor within 6 Angstrom of kinase gamma; nearest sampled distances are 27-38 Angstrom or absent.
aPKC/Par6/Lgl 8R3Y places the nearest Lgl hydroxyl 12.560 Angstrom from ANP PG; mTORC2 ATP-state rows keep heteromeric acceptors at least 25.9 Angstrom away or lack active gamma.

Adjacent dephosphorylated/unphosphorylated substrate wording returned 21 RCSB rows across 18 unique PDB IDs and 0 heteromeric gamma/acceptor candidates; 2QO7 and 3Q4Z are same-entity kinase regulatory states, not substrate transfer complexes.
The same Michaelis/transition pass found 0 fresh folded-protein positives: 3X2U/3X2V/3X2W are peptide repeats and 5HVK is the known LIMK1/cofilin repeat.

Broad ATP-analog/gamma-transfer alias scout reviewed 402 unique PDB IDs; it found repeat peptide positives 1IR3/2PHK/4IAC and counterexample transporter rows 7ZDU/7ZE5, with 0 fresh folded-protein positives.
evidence_for: Repeat review-only folded-protein positive-like evidence recovered again: 5HVK LIMK1/cofilin Ser3 near ANP PG.
Michaelis/transition-state wording recovered repeat peptide positives 3X2U/3X2V/3X2W with PKA substrate peptide Ser621 3.517-3.529 Angstrom from ATP PG, plus repeat folded 5HVK.
ATP-analog/gamma-transfer aliases recovered repeat peptide positives 1IR3, 2PHK, and 4IAC for review-only stress coverage.

metadata.hypothesis: A bounded RCSB/PubMed route for full-length kinase-substrate complexes with ATP/analog and phosphorylation-site wording may expose fresh non-topology-confounded folded-protein ePK positive evidence.
metadata.ncbi_eutils_blocker: HTTP 429 on bounded PubMed ESearch/ESummary; Europe PMC fallback completed.
metadata.primary_outcome_reason: The phrase search recovered only repeat 5HVK; PubMed-derived family leads either split kinase-substrate and nucleotide states or lack local gamma-to-acceptor geometry.
